meta.name: arize-instrumentation
meta.description: INVOKE THIS SKILL when adding Arize AX tracing or observability to an app for the first time, or when the user wants to instrument their LLM app or get started with LLM observability. Follow the Agent-Assisted Tracing two-phase flow: analyze the codebase (read-only), then implement after user confirmation. When the app uses LLM tool/function calling, add manual CHAIN + TOOL spans. Leverages https://arize.com/docs/ax/alyx/tracing-assistant and https://arize.com/docs/PROMPT.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LLM 应用添加可观测性追踪
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在开发 LLM 应用并需要追踪调用链
copy.tagline_en: Add observability tracing to your LLM app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing an LLM app and need to trace call chains

howto.what: Claude 会分析你的代码库（只读），检测语言、包管理器和 LLM 框架，然后根据分析结果建议并帮你添加 Arize AX 追踪。它遵循两阶段流程：先分析，等你确认后再实施。
howto.when: 当你第一次想给应用添加 Arize AX 追踪或观测性，或者你想让自己的 LLM 应用接入追踪时触发。你要求“设置追踪”或“用 Arize 打点”时也会启动。

say.text: 帮我的 Python 项目加上 Arize 追踪。
检查我的代码里有没有现有的追踪配置。
say.note: 它会扫描环境变量和依赖。

say.text: 在 Anthropic 调用周围添加手动 CHAIN 和 TOOL 跨度。
say.note: 当应用使用工具调用时。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your codebase (read-only) to detect language, package manager, and LLM frameworks, then suggests and helps add Arize AX tracing. It follows a two-phase flow: analyze first, implement after your confirmation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to add Arize AX tracing or observability to an app for the first time, or when you ask to instrument your LLM app. Also triggered by requests like 'set up tracing' or 'instrument my app with Arize'.

say_en.text: Add Arize tracing to my Python project.
say_en.note: It will analyze the project structure first.

say_en.text: Check my code for existing tracing setup.
say_en.note: It scans env vars and dependencies.

say_en.text: Add manual CHAIN and TOOL spans around Anthropic calls.
say_en.note: When the app uses tool calling.
